profile.subtitleJa: ゲラの子、ベニヤミン人
profile.summaryJa: サムエル記下16:5は、シムイをゲラの子、バフリム出身のベニヤミン人として紹介します。
profile.identityNoteJa: シメア（ダビデの兄弟）など、同じ記事に列挙される別人とは区別する。

facts.textJa: シムイはダビデに呪いの言葉を浴びせ、石を投げます。
ダビデが戻ると、シムイは赦しを求め、ダビデはその日に彼を殺さないと誓います。

wikipedia.title: Shimei
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版記事は、ゲラの子シムイをベニヤミン人として挙げ、ダビデを呪った場面と帰還時の赦しを説明します。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: When King David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera. He came out and cursed as he came.
Shimei said when he cursed, “Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!
So David and his men went by the way; and Shimei went along on the hillside opposite him and cursed as he went, threw stones at him, and threw dust.
Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.
A ferry boat went to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king when he had come over the Jordan.
But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?”
The king said to Shimei, “You will not die.” The king swore to him.
